splitPolicy.identityNormalization: Treat p2a and p2b as participant p2 so repeated recordings never cross splits.
splitPolicy.rule: Assign participant groups before extracting frames; no participant may cross train, validation, or test splits. Balance both routes within every split.

attribution.text: The Way Up: A Dataset for Hold Usage Detection in Sport Climbing, Anna Maschek and David C. Schedl, CC BY 4.0, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15196867

privacy.biometricRisk: pose and movement data may identify or profile participants

consentReview.evidence: The accompanying paper states that all participants provided informed consent for filming and dataset publication.
consentReview.limitation: Publication consent is not treated as blanket consent for biometric identification or individual profiling. Do not identify participants.

privacy.nonParticipantFaces: Publisher reports that faces of non-participating individuals were blurred.
privacy.requiredBeforeTraining: Reconfirm the release contents match the paper, minimize person data, and document the intended model-training purpose.

takedown.onNotice: Quarantine affected assets, stop new training jobs, record the notice, and rebuild affected dataset versions.

excludedSources.reason: The academic download flow directs commercial users to obtain a separate commercial license.
The documented participant permission is for scientific purposes; commercial training rights are not established.
Public viewing and YouTube's standard license do not grant commercial model-training rights.
Items without verifiable commercial, derivative, and model-training rights remain metadata-only.

athleteUploads.withdrawalAction: Remove future dataset versions and rebuild affected trainable artifacts when required.
